TAL_DARK_MELD.why: Meld's generic typed save row has no grant effect; combat/ext/docket_senses.py compiles its per-talent Meld actions instead.

tianxia.subpath.body.sumo.feature.yokozu.name: Yokozuna Presence
tianxia.subpath.body.sumo.feature.yokozu.why: While Rooted Stance is active: hostile creatures treat spaces within 10 feet of it as difficult terrain (an aura that moves with it), and an ally within 5 feet whose attacker's line crosses its space has Half Cover against ranged attacks (combat/ext/docket_terrain.py). The Intimidation lines are outside the fight; no creature moves through another's space on this table.
